remarks: Highly sought after and beautifully landscaped Winnipauk Village community! Sun filled, end unit three-floor townhouse, with private deck and open outdoor green space. Large living room with wood burning fireplace and sliding doors, dining room with plenty of light coming through picture windows. Wood floors throughout. Bright and sunny Eat-in-kitchen with stainless steel appliances. Two en-suite bedrooms with full baths and plenty of closet space. Expansive lower level perfect for family room, work from home office space, or anything else your heart desires. Dedicated parking and plenty of other spaces for your guests as well. Relax by the 2 serene inground pools and patio space. Fitness Center, Clubhouse for events, brand new tennis and pickleball courts that light up for nighttime play. Secured entry from one side of the complex. A quiet retreat, yet close to plenty of amenities; library, dining, shopping, entertainment, parks, train station, major highways, hiking trails. Easy commute to NYC!
